thread:
lina: Alerting: multiple nodes in gpu-pool-3 showing OOM / CUDA errors, containers restarting repeatedly. seeing cuMemAlloc failures in runtime logs.  😬
rafa: On it. which nodes? any customer impact?
lina: nodes: node-3c, node-3d, node-3f. High 95/99 latencies for some routes, a handful of 502s. Incident bot created SEV2 incident ID INC-2026-142.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-142 created by monitoring. Priority: SEV2. Impact: degraded inference latency and errors for ~2% of traffic to hosted models in us-west. Pager oncall: @rafa.
rafa: copying logs into thread. short snippets: 
```
E 03:12:45 runtime.cpp:421 cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory (err=2)
W 03:12:46 allocator.cpp:287 page_alloc_fragmented: free_pages low, fragmentation > 0.78
I 03:13:02 kv_cache.cpp:1143 evict_scan: scanned 1.2M slots, reclaimed 1.9%
```
micah: those fragmentation numbers look like the slow-drip we've seen before. likely paged-attention allocator not compacting; KV cache sticky pages.
ava: any recent rollout or config change to eviction or compaction?
lina: no prod rollouts in last 24h, but dedup of small batches enabled earlier this week. possible steady-state different sequence lengths.
rafa: mitigation plan: 1) raise node-level eviction aggressiveness -> set env REDWOOD_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.5 on affected nodes, 2) enable allocator compact-scan flag (allocator.compact_scan=true) to trigger background defrag, 3) gracefully drain node-3f and restart runtime container after flag flip, 4) route traffic away for 10m while verifying.
ops: can do drains + restarts. will coordinate with scc.
sre-bot: Runbook reference: paged-allocator slow-creep response v2. Steps: increase eviction, enable compact-scan, restart runtime with --compact-scan.
rafa: step 1 applied to node-3f and node-3d. watching memory.
micah: please also roll back small-batch dedup temporarily on those nodes to reduce sticky KV usage: set REDWOOD_BATCH_DEDUP=false.
ava: started draining node-3f at 03:20. moving pods off and marking as cordoned.
rafa: observing immediate reduction in cuMemAlloc errors on node-3f after compact-scan enabled + restart. node-3d still noisy.
lina: customer impact note for SEV: affected routes are text-generation/standard and streaming chat on us-west. approx 2% of requests saw elevated latency and ~0.1% 502; no data loss. informing support.
ops: node-3d will be restarted next. scheduling restart in 2m.
rafa: restarted node-3d runtime container. after restart, allocator fragmentation metric dropped from 0.82 -> 0.46 and free pages increased.
oncall-bot: Update: mitigation actions applied. Monitoring for 30m.
micah: long-term, we should add aggressive periodic compaction and improve our compact-scan heuristic to run under fragmentation>0.6. also need a KV eviction metric alarm earlier.
ava: noted: creating GH issue for allocator heuristics and adding runbook step for batch-dedup interaction.
lina: handing off to night oncall. summary for next oncall:
- Incident INC-2026-142: paged-attention/KV cache fragmentation causing slow memory creep -> cuMemAlloc OOMs and container restarts, node flaps.
- Mitigations done: increased eviction (0.5), enabled allocator.compact_scan, drained + restarted node-3f + node-3d, temporarily disabled batch dedup on affected nodes.
- Current status: error rates back to baseline, fragmentation metric decreased, nodes stable. continue 30m observation.
- Follow-ups: add alarm for fragmentation > 0.6, compact-scan as auto-action, investigate batch-dedup vs KV stickiness regression, ensure safe default eviction.
rafa: will own follow-ups. ping me if anything flares overnight. :thumbsup:
ops: handoff complete. cordon removed for nodes after stability verified.
micah: thanks team. closing thread after observation window if stable. :white_check_mark:
